messages:
mira: quick preflight — nz-south project created but we don't have VPC/subnets yet. planning to bring up a small gpu cluster (4 x A10g) next week, any quota/region gotchas?
alex: I spun up the GCP project `redwood-nzx-ml` (projectId: redwood-nzx-ml, number: 9876543210). left a note in the cloud-accounts sheet.
sam: nice. do we have a standard CIDR to use for new regions? want to avoid overlap with customer VPNs.
alex: use `10.240.0.0/16` for nzx by default. subnets: `10.240.0.0/20` control plane, `10.240.16.0/20` nodes, `10.240.32.0/22` services. added to terraform var file.
mira: copied. Also need the VPC peering and routes for prometheus scrape access from monitoring-prod.
karen: FYI nz region currently has a limit of 32 GPUs per project unless we request quota increase. for A10g we'll need a quota request ticket. Costwise expect ~ $1.2k/day for 4x A10g on demand.
jose: can we start with preemptible to validate network and k8s config? saves cost during smoke tests.
alex: yes, terraform has `node_preemptible = true` toggle. i've made a branch `infra/nzx-vpc` with configs.
mira: sending the quota request now — ticket #INC-4521. cc @karen
sam: for the VPC, please add these firewall rules: `allow-internal` tcp 0-65535 10.240.0.0/16, `prom-scrape` tcp 9100,9090 from monitoring-prod CIDR. also enable Private Google Access on subnets.
devops-bot: deploy plan for infra/nzx-vpc ran: `terraform plan` OK, 12 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy. plan output: https://ci.redwood/plan/4321
alex: after plan apply we should validate: 1) subnets exist, 2) route to monitoring, 3) IAM service account `redwood-nzx-node-sa` has compute admin? needs limited perms: compute.instanceAdmin + iam.serviceAccountUser.
mira: i'll run smoke cluster with 1 control, 1 gpu node (preemptible) midday tomorrow. can someone watch cluster-autoscaler logs once it's up?
jose: happy to. also checklist for handoff: share terraform state path, project number, billing account id, quota ticket, and any region-specific notes. add to the region-onboard doc.
karen: reminder: if we convert to dedicated capacity later, we should reserve instances or use committed use discounts — involves separate procurement approval.
sam: one last note — enable VPC flow logs for the node subnets for 7 days (short retention) to help quick triage.
mira: perfect, thanks everyone. i'll follow up in the AM with apply output and thread closure.
alex: :thumbsup:
